topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I don't understand how this all happened. I spent so many nights working on that project, pouring over every detail, making sure everything was just right. And now, suddenly, there's this accusation hanging over me. I mean, I cited all my sources, didn’t I? I thought I did. Maybe I missed something. I’ll have to go back and check. It’s just, I never meant to do anything wrong. I really cared about that assignment. I want to talk to the professor, explain, but every time I imagine the conversation, the words get tangled up. I just need to figure out how to make this right.
